description: Shadow rainfall-amount and range forecast from a rainfall-distribution model (scripts/dist_shadow.py, docs/48). Cycles are matched by initialization month and season, so future cycle files are covered without editing this file. Shadow forecasts are never published as forecasts; the published probabilities and amounts are unchanged. Besides the configured model (EMOS), every distribution model the method selection (scripts/method_selection.py) lists as a candidate for a cycle gets its own shadow, so its independent validation seasons accumulate.
reason: In Phase 2 the EMOS 10-90% intervals held 76-84% of observed totals where the MVS-corrected ensemble's held 46-76% (80% is calibrated), and EMOS was confirmed better in CRPS for the January-initialized FMAM season and JJAS September. The shadow builds independent evidence season by season before any amount or range product is considered.
members_note: Ensemble members per model, as in the model's benchmark: the DRN (docs/54) was benchmarked with the first 25 SEAS5 members in every year.
